projects.display_name: Ironbridge operations system (facilities, permits, profiles, manifests)

datasets.description: The operations system: facilities and their units, permitted codes, weekly capacity bookings, generators, waste profiles and analyticals, manifests, receipts, holds and third-party outlets. Extracted nightly at 02:00.

tables.label: Facilities
tables.carries: Permitted facilities with business, state, kind and acquisition.

tables.label: Treatment units with permitted capacity and cost
tables.carries: Permitted tons a year, treatment cost a ton, halogen limit.

tables.label: Waste codes permitted by unit
tables.grain: one facility x process x waste code
tables.carries: Which codes each unit may receive.

tables.label: Weekly capacity bookings by unit
tables.grain: one facility x process x week
tables.carries: Tons booked against weekly capacity, 52 weeks.

tables.label: Generators (customers)
tables.carries: Customers with industry, origin region, state, tier and account manager.

tables.label: Waste profiles
tables.carries: The characterisation of one waste stream from one generator: form, codes, tons a year, outlet, status, price.

tables.label: Laboratory results by profile

tables.carries: Released results from Riverbend laboratory.

tables.label: Manifests (shipments)
tables.carries: Every shipment this year: generator, profile, receiving facility and unit, tons, dates, status, revenue and full cost.

tables.label: Receipt discrepancies (off-spec)
tables.carries: What the facility found at receipt that the profile did not say.

tables.label: Shipments held at service centers
tables.carries: Arrival and departure at the service center against the ten-day limit.

tables.label: Third-party outlets
tables.carries: Outlets outside the network with process, cost and approval status.

tables.label: Shipments to third-party outlets
tables.carries: Tons, revenue and outlet cost for shipments routed outside the network this year.

tables.label: Profiles approved at third-party outlets
tables.carries: Profile-level approvals with cost and expiry.

datasets.description: Price book, quotes, cost rates, transport lanes, state fees and invoice lines. Refreshed nightly.

tables.label: Price book 2026
tables.carries: Price a ton by process, effective 5 January 2026.

tables.label: Quotes
tables.carries: Quotes issued this year with status, due date and turnaround.

tables.label: Quote lines
tables.carries: Price and routing per stream on a quote.

tables.label: Treatment cost rates
tables.carries: Internal cost a ton by unit, from the cost model.

tables.label: Transport lanes
tables.carries: Dollars a ton by origin region and facility, from the 2026 rate card.

tables.label: State disposal fees
tables.carries: Fee a ton by state, before and from 1 November 2026.

tables.label: Invoice lines (revenue) to 30 September
tables.carries: Revenue and full cost per received shipment, January to September.

tables.label: FY26 revenue plan by business and month
tables.carries: The board-approved plan the revenue is measured against.

ops.facility.label: state
ops.facility.description: State the facility is in; sets the disposal fee.

ops.facility.label: facility_kind
ops.facility.description: Rotary kiln incinerator, deep well, landfill, fuel blending, service center and others.

ops.facility.label: acquired_from
ops.facility.description: Harbor Line Environmental or Tidewater Reclamation for the acquired sites; null otherwise.

ops.process_unit.label: process_code
ops.process_unit.description: INC_AQ, INC_ORG, INC_SOL, INC_LP, FB, SR, AQ, STAB, DW, AER, CYL, LF.

ops.process_unit.label: permitted_tons_year
ops.process_unit.description: Permitted throughput in tons a year.

ops.process_unit.label: treatment_cost_usd_ton
ops.process_unit.description: Internal treatment cost a ton at the unit, from the cost model.

ops.process_unit.label: halogen_limit_pct
ops.process_unit.description: Total halogen limit for fuel blending, percent by weight. Null elsewhere.

ops.facility_permit_code.label: waste_code
ops.facility_permit_code.description: RCRA or state code (D001, F003, K048, STATE-TX, NONHAZ).

ops.capacity_booking.label: booked_tons
ops.capacity_booking.description: Tons booked for the week from manifests and standing bookings.

ops.capacity_booking.label: capacity_tons
ops.capacity_booking.description: Permitted tons a year divided by 52.

ops.capacity_booking.label: outage
ops.capacity_booking.description: True when the unit is down for the week.

ops.generator.label: origin_region
ops.generator.description: Origin region for the rate card (TX-Gulf, IN, NJ).

ops.generator.label: epa_id
ops.generator.description: EPA identification number. Empty until issued.

ops.waste_profile.label: physical_form
ops.waste_profile.description: Aqueous liquid, organic liquid, solids, sludge, lab pack, aerosol cans, gas cylinders.

ops.waste_profile.label: waste_codes
ops.waste_profile.description: RCRA and state codes, comma separated.

ops.waste_profile.label: annual_tons
ops.waste_profile.description: Tons a year the generator expects.

ops.waste_profile.label: process_code
ops.waste_profile.description: Approved outlet unit. Null while pending.

ops.waste_profile.label: facility_code
ops.waste_profile.description: Approved outlet facility. Null while pending.

ops.waste_profile.label: legacy_system
ops.waste_profile.description: True when the profile is in LegacyTrack (Harbor Line, Tidewater) and has not been reviewed.

ops.waste_profile.label: container
ops.waste_profile.description: Bulk tanker, roll-off, drums, lab pack boxes, drums of cans, cylinders.

ops.waste_profile.label: total_halogens_pct
ops.waste_profile.description: Total halogens by weight where measured.

ops.waste_profile.label: customer_requirement
ops.waste_profile.description: A requirement stated on the profile (destruction with a certificate, no landfill).

ops.profile_analytical.label: parameter
ops.profile_analytical.description: pH, flash point, heat value, total halogens, active ingredient, methanol, total suspended solids.

ops.profile_analytical.label: released_on
ops.profile_analytical.description: Date the laboratory released the result. A result not released is not a result.

ops.manifest.label: via_center
ops.manifest.description: Service center the shipment went through. Null when direct.

ops.manifest.label: received_on
ops.manifest.description: Receipt at the facility. Null until received.

ops.manifest.label: off_spec
ops.manifest.description: True when a receipt discrepancy was recorded.

ops.manifest.label: price_usd_ton
ops.manifest.description: Price a ton on the profile.

ops.manifest.label: full_cost_usd
ops.manifest.description: Treatment, handling, state fee and transport for the shipment, from the cost model.

ops.manifest.label: booked_week
ops.manifest.description: Week the receiving unit holds the booking.

ops.receipt_discrepancy.label: discrepancy_kind
ops.receipt_discrepancy.description: pH outside range, free liquids, halogens above profile, container count, unlisted constituent, weight.

ops.receipt_discrepancy.label: resolution
ops.receipt_discrepancy.description: Re-profiled, accepted with surcharge, rejected and returned, accepted after re-sampling.

ops.transfer_hold.label: left_on
ops.transfer_hold.description: Departure. Null while on the pad.

ops.transfer_hold.label: exceeded_ten_days
ops.transfer_hold.description: True when the hold ran past ten days.

ops.transfer_hold.label: deadline
ops.transfer_hold.description: Tenth day after arrival for shipments still on the pad.

ops.third_party_outlet.label: cost_usd_ton
ops.third_party_outlet.description: Outlet cost a ton on the approval.

fin.quote.label: issued_on
fin.quote.description: Issue date. Null for a draft.

fin.quote.label: due_on
fin.quote.description: Date the customer asked for it.

fin.quote.label: status
fin.quote.description: Draft, Open, Won, Lost or Expired.

fin.quote_line.label: book_price_usd_ton
fin.quote_line.description: Price book price a ton at the time.

legacy.legacy_profile.description: Generator name as the acquired company recorded it.
